question: Why can even immense material wealth not equal the value of this Kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
Even this is incomparable to the teaching
inference: Even possession of an ocean full of jewels cannot match the value of this teaching.
uncertainties: The segmentation and meaning of akretuṃ within the fused token are unclear
plain_english: Even if one possessed an accumulation like an ocean filled with jewels...
